announcements.headline: Fortuna Reports Results for the Third Quarter 2026
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) reports third quarter 2026 results. This follows recent exploration updates and the scheduled release date announced in October.

announcements.headline: Fortuna Advances Diamba Sud Gold Project Permitting in Senegal
announcements.insight: Fortuna advances Diamba Sud permitting following October drilling results. This operational progress supports ongoing project development.

announcements.headline: Fortuna intersects 1.9 g/t gold over 64 meters, confirming broad gold mineralization at Kabewest, Bambadji Project, Senegal
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp reports further gold mineralization at its Bambadji Project. This follows earlier intersections at Diamba Sud and Lindero, indicating continued exploration progress across its portfolio.

announcements.headline: Fortuna to release third quarter 2026 financial results on November 4, 2026; Conference call at 12 p.m. Eastern time on November 5, 2026
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) has scheduled its third quarter 2026 financial results release for November 4, 2026. This follows recent production updates and exploration advances reported in October.

announcements.headline: Fortuna intersects 0.96 g/t gold over 350 meters at the Lindero Mine, Argentina
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp reports gold intersections at Lindero Mine. This follows earlier updates on Séguéla expansion and Southern Arc drilling.

announcements.headline: Fortuna intersects 7.8 g/t gold over 12.8 meters at Southern Arc, Diamba Sud, and advances exploration at Bambadji, Senegal
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp reports exploration results at Southern Arc and advances work at Bambadji. This follows recent production updates and capacity expansion approvals.

announcements.headline: Fortuna reports third quarter 2026 production of 69,665 gold equivalent ounces and advances key growth initiatives
announcements.insight: Fortuna reports Q3 production figures following its Q2 results in August. This update follows the recent approval of capacity expansion at Séguéla.

announcements.headline: Fortuna CEO to present at Mining Forum Americas 2026
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) CEO to present at Mining Forum Americas 2026. This follows recent production updates and feasibility study filings for the Diamba Sud project.

announcements.headline: Fortuna Reports Results for the Second Quarter 2026
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) reports second quarter 2026 financial results. This follows earlier production updates and feasibility study filings for its Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire projects.

announcements.headline: Fortuna Approves 30% Capacity Expansion of the Séguéla Gold Mine in Côte d’Ivoire
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp expands Séguéla Gold Mine capacity by 30%, following recent feasibility studies for Diamba Sud. This signals continued capital investment in its asset portfolio.

announcements.headline: Fortuna to release second quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026; Conference call at 12 p.m. Eastern time on August 6, 2026
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) will release second quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026. Shareholders should watch for performance metrics following recent production updates and feasibility study filings.

announcements.headline: Fortuna Files Feasibility Study Technical Report for the Diamba Sud Gold Project, Senegal
announcements.insight: Following June approvals, the feasibility study advances the Diamba Sud project toward production. Q2 output confirms operational momentum.

announcements.headline: Fortuna reports second quarter 2026 production of 72,217 gold equivalent ounces and advances key growth initiatives
announcements.insight: Fortuna reports Q2 production figures while advancing the Diamba Sud project following its feasibility study. Shareholders should monitor progress on this key growth initiative.

announcements.headline: Fortuna delivers robust Feasibility Study for the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal: After-tax IRR of 60% and NPV5% of US$1 billion using US$3,500/oz
announcements.insight: The feasibility study follows June environmental approval, confirming project viability. This robust financial profile supports advancement toward development.

announcements.headline: Fortuna reports voting results of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders
announcements.insight: Fortuna reports voting results of its 2026 annual general meeting. This follows earlier sustainability reporting and environmental approval for the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal.

announcements.headline: Fortuna obtains key environmental approval for Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal
announcements.insight: Obtaining key environmental approval for the Diamba Sud Gold Project advances development. This follows the 2025 Sustainability Report published in May.

announcements.headline: Fortuna publishes its 2025 Sustainability Report
announcements.insight: Fortuna Mining Corp Ord Shs (0QYM) has published its 2025 Sustainability Report. Shareholders should monitor future filings for operational or financial updates.
